## What it is

`csemapp` packages the **cSEM GUI**, a Shiny application for partial least
squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM) built on the
[cSEM](https://cran.r-project.org/package=cSEM) package. You draw the model on a
canvas, choose an analysis, and read the results in report tables that can be
copied to Word or Excel or downloaded as Excel workbooks.

## Start the app

```{r}
library(csemapp)
run_csem_gui()      # opens the app in your web browser
csem_gui_guide()    # prints the full step-by-step guide to the console
```

To run it on a server (shiny-server, shinyapps.io, Posit Connect), create an
`app.R` that contains:

```{r}
csemapp::csem_gui_app()
```

## A first analysis

1. In the left panel tick **Use cSEM demo data (satisfaction)**, or upload your
   own CSV file (header row, numeric indicators).
2. Click **Load example model** (demo data) or drag variables onto the canvas to
   create constructs, then use the **Connect** tool to draw paths.
3. Open the **Calculate** menu, choose **PLS-SEM algorithm** and start.
4. Read the **Results diagram** tab (loadings, path coefficients, R-square) and
   the **cSEM report** tab (all tables).

## Analyses in the Calculate menu

| Menu item | What it does | Result tab |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PLS-SEM algorithm | PLS estimation | Results diagram, cSEM report |
| Consistent PLS-SEM algorithm | PLSc: corrects common-factor constructs for measurement error | Results diagram, cSEM report |
| Bootstrapping / consistent PLS bootstrapping | standard errors, t and p values, confidence intervals (parallel) | Bootstrapping report |
| IPMA | importance-performance map for a target construct | IPMA |
| Confirmatory tetrad analysis | tests a reflective measurement specification | Confirmatory tetrad analysis |
| PLSpredict and CVPAT | k-fold out-of-sample prediction and predictive ability test | PLSpredict, CVPAT |

Moderators and quadratic effects are added in the model builder. PLSpredict and
CVPAT work for linear models only.

## Reading the tables

Report tables are coloured green when a common cut-off is met and red when it
is not: loadings at least 0.70, reliability at least 0.70, AVE at least 0.50,
HTMT below 0.90, VIF at most 5, SRMR below 0.08, NFI at least 0.90, and for
PLSpredict Q2 predict above 0. Each table has a **Copy** button and each tab a
**Download Excel** button.

## More help

`csem_gui_guide()` prints the complete guide: loading data, every model-builder
shortcut, the settings of each analysis, the meaning of each table and a
troubleshooting list.

```{r}
?run_csem_gui
?csem_gui_guide
```
